title: Emperors clothes
content:
This elegant royal robe was designed with inspiration from ancient noble attire — featuring deep navy fabric, intricate golden ornaments, and a luxurious silhouette.  
I aimed to create a balance between fantasy and historical fashion.  
What do you think about the combination of dark tones with gold details? 💫  
Your feedback means a lot — feel free to share your thoughts!

![44c5fbb8f28b4cbe806357108024c5fd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/44c5fbb8f28b4cbe806357108024c5fdpreview%2001.png)![40755d8e881b45e1a32ab27c2b1251d6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/40755d8e881b45e1a32ab27c2b1251d6preview%2002.png)![313ec1e352b54945b9feddc64672b335](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/313ec1e352b54945b9feddc64672b335preview%2004.png)![bcd1b8363b6d41378eed099cdc05b55c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/bcd1b8363b6d41378eed099cdc05b55cpreview%2003.png)3D Artist: Zeinab Dahgani

Portfolio: [www.cv.zeinabdahgani.com](http://www.cv.zeinabdahgani.com)

instagram: <https://www.instagram.com/zeinab_dahgani/>

title: Soft Dreams 🧸✨
content:
Fluff, ruffles, and pure softness — these two looks are all about comfort meeting fantasy. ☁️✨  
Between dreamy layers and plush textures, _Soft Whispers_ and _Teddy Reverie_ explore the cutest side of fashion: where nostalgia, playfulness, and elegance live together in harmony.

Each detail tells a small story — floating fabrics, teddy-inspired textures, and pastel tones that feel like a warm hug. 💕  
Because sometimes, fashion isn’t about being loud… it’s about feeling _safe, cozy, and beautifully soft._ 🤎🧸

title: [Contest] Show Your Style on the Fairway ⛳️ Join the Contest!
content:
Hello Creators,  
This is the CONNECT Team.

We’re excited to announce that the **Timeless Fairway Design Contest** , in collaboration with the golf wear brand **Fairliar** , is now open! ⛳️

![51ade5b0b7724f7cbbe23b451c37d511](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/d3c4aa1aae9843868cd19637d0d5b82d/images/51ade5b0b7724f7cbbe23b451c37d511Image%20%283%29.png)

Complete your look with at least one **golf accessory** — such as a visor, hip bag, or golf shoes — and showcase your unique sense of style.

  
Express your refined and functional golf fashion, and become one of the winners of **over $8,000 in total prizes!** ✨

📅 Submission period: Oct 15 – Nov 13, 2025

🏆 Results announced: Nov 24, 2025

🔗 Check the full details and submit here: [**[LINK]**](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/timeless_fairway)

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out via comments or our Instagram([@letsconnect3d](https://www.instagram.com/letsconnect3d/)).

We can’t wait to see your amazing creations!❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello, Can everyone participate?

title: “Internal Line Cut Function Fails After Latest Update (Mac Version)”
content:
Hi dear CLO Team,

  
After the latest CLO 3D update, the **Cut Internal Line** function sometimes fails even when the internal line correctly intersects the pattern outline. This happens on my **MacBook Pro M3 (2024)** and also on my colleague’s system.  
The issue occurs with both new and old files that previously worked fine.  
Please check if this is a known bug in the current version.

Best regards,

Vida

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, we’re aware of this bug and are already working on a fix. Sorry for the inconvenience! If needed, you can temporarily install an older version from the CLO website.
content_description: This page serves to report and seek confirmation on a potential bug affecting the "Cut Internal Line" function in CLO 3D on MacBook Pro M3 systems following the latest update.

title: Unreal Engine Clipping
content:
Hello,

I’m experiencing issues with the Unreal Engine LiveSync. There’s always clipping — the avatar keeps poking through the mesh. I’ve repeated and checked every step in the documentation multiple times, but the clipping persists no matter what I try.

In addition, the textures are sometimes misaligned and don’t fit properly on the garment.

I’m using the latest version of CLO3D together with Unreal Engine version 5.6.1.

The version 5.6.0 that you recommend is no longer available and cannot be installed — only 5.6.1 is currently accessible.

Could this issue be related to the version, or are there any other possible solutions?

If it is indeed version-related, how are we supposed to work with it if Unreal Engine no longer provides version 5.6.0?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi mah3r, my apologies for the delayed response as I was out of office for a few days last week. The clipping issue may occur when the transform values for the Static Mesh or Geometry Cache assets are not aligned, or when the simulated results are already clipping in CLO. I don’t believe this is version-related, and I’d like to investigate the issue further.Could you please submit a Zendesk support ticket and mention my name? I’ll follow up with the developers. When submitting the ticket, it would be very helpful if you could include a video demonstrating the issue, along with the CLO project file if possible.Thanks!Best regards,Bryan

Comment 2: Hi there, our colleague will get back to you asap.
content_description: This page aims to provide troubleshooting guidance and version compatibility information for resolving avatar clipping and texture alignment issues when using CLO3D with Unreal Engine LiveSync.
